developer_key.title: Developer key
developer_key.description: The When I Work developer key used to authenticate login requests.

email.title: Email
email.description: The email address of the When I Work person to authenticate.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password of the When I Work person to authenticate.

workplace_user_id.title: Workplace user ID
workplace_user_id.description: The optional workplace user ID sent as W-UserId to select the account.

start_date.title: History start date
start_date.description: The inclusive start date for date-bounded collections; defaults to 365 days before the read.

end_date.title: Coverage end date
end_date.description: The end boundary for date-bounded collections; defaults to 90 days after the read, with at most 20 years of coverage.
